body:
Maya L: ops-bot just opened an incident for increased 5xx on /v1/generate — linking war room now: https://warroom.internal/redwood/2468104321 — can oncall confirm paging? 
Tess (oncall): I see the pager, I'm live in the war room and taking owner. joining. :handshake:
Samir P: Thanks Tess. Quick ask — please confirm whether customer-facing status page needs a 'partial outage' or 'degraded performance' state. Any initial scope?
Tess (oncall): Initial read: ~15% of requests getting 502/503, mostly at seq len ~2048, affects hosted inference in us-west-2. Clients intermittently seeing failures but most requests succeed. I'd lean "degraded performance" but mark as "partial outage" if it persists.
Jai K: Oncall, can you run a quick check on dedicated pools? run: `curl -s https://internal-api/health | jq .pools` — curious if routing fallback kicked in.
Tess (oncall): Running check now. output: `{"hosts_unhealthy": 3, "fallbacks": 7, "avg_latency_ms": 320}` — looks like several hosts returned KV cache errors, causing retries.
Maya L: Copy. Samir, recommend we prepare a brief status page update in case leadership needs to notify customers. Draft below — please edit: 
```
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting a subset of requests to the Redwood Hosted API (text generation endpoints) in US-West. Impact: some requests may fail or see increased latency. Mitigation: traffic routing to fallback pools, restart of 3 affected inference hosts in progress. Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have root cause.
```
Samir P: LGTM — small wording tweak: add "no data loss" and mention customer keys unaffected.
Maya L: Updated draft: 
```
We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting a subset of requests to the Redwood Hosted API (text-generation endpoints) in US-West. Impact: some requests may fail or see increased latency. No customer data was exposed and API keys are unaffected. Mitigation: automated routing to fallback pools is active; targeted restarts of affected hosts are underway. Next update: 15 minutes or when we have new info.
```
Tess (oncall): I confirmed restarts started at 2468104350. Paging of secondary oncall (Samir) — can you join to help with host triage? @Samir P
Samir P: joining war room. pulling logs from the affected hosts now: `stern inference-.* | grep -i "kv_cache|oom|segfault"`
ops-bot: Incident 2468104321 created by monitoring-alert. Severity: p2. Pager rota: Tess (oncall) primary, Samir P secondary. War room: https://warroom.internal/redwood/2468104321.
deploy-bot: Noting active restarts on hosts: host-27, host-33, host-41. CI drains started.
Jai K: Quick mitigation suggestion: temporarily lower max_seq_len for hosted API to 1024 for routed requests to reduce memory pressure — can we flip that as a short-lived policy?
Tess (oncall): Good idea. I'll apply a temporary routing policy to cap seq_len for new sessions. Applying now.
Maya L: Thanks. Samir — when you have logs, post the first actionable root cause hypothesis here (e.g., kernel OOM vs model memory leak vs runtime regression). Then we can decide status-page severity upgrade.
Samir P: Early signs point to a KV-cache eviction bug triggered by long sequences under quantized kernels; narrowing down to commit `runtime/kv-cache#c8a4d`. Will confirm in ~10m.
Tess (oncall): Acknowledged. For handoff later, I'll note actions taken: took owner, applied seq_len cap, initiated 3 host restarts, prepared status page draft, requested Samir for logs.
Maya L: Copy. I'm preparing the customer-facing notice if we need it. Samir/Tess please ping when you want me to publish.
Tess (oncall): Paging confirmation: primary paged, secondary paged, war room active. :white_check_mark:
Maya L: Closing loop for now — will post status page if root cause confirmed as widespread. Keep updates short and timestamped.
Samir P: Update in ~8m with log snippet.
ops-bot: Reminder — please run the post-incident checklist once resolved: /incident checklist 2468104321
Maya L: Thanks all, stay on thread.
